technique_name: Write a paragraph about robots in India.
description: Robots are becoming increasingly prevalent in India, both in industry and in everyday life. Robot-assisted automation and artificial intelligence are being used in a variety of industries ranging from banking and finance to automotive manufacturing. Private firms, universities, and non-profits are also developing robots with a social purpose.
